zones.label: Reach
zones.summary: Identify who participated, who did not, and why.
facts: Count access as well as exposure.
High reach can still exclude important groups.

zones.label: Quality
zones.summary: Assess whether the intervention was delivered as intended and respectfully.
facts: Measure training, fidelity, adaptation, and participant experience.
Quality includes cultural and disability access.

zones.label: Outcomes
zones.summary: Measure meaningful short- and long-term changes linked to the goal.
facts: Distinguish activity counts from health outcomes.
Use multiple evidence sources when appropriate.

zones.label: Equity
zones.summary: Compare access, experience, benefits, and burdens across groups.
facts: Do not treat identity as the cause of disparity.
Revise barriers revealed by the data.

zones.label: Unintended Effects
zones.summary: Look for unexpected benefits, harms, displacement, stigma, or behavior changes.
facts: Stop or revise avoidable harm quickly.
